description: TikTok API: Get a TikTok video. Description, hashtags, creation date, duration, author, sound, views, likes, comments, shares and saves of a video, and the languages of its captions. Price: 2 credits per call; failed calls are free.

video_id.description: Numeric video ID: the number at the end of a video link (use `/resolve` for a short link)
